scope: GPT-2 124M only, native macOS CoreML backend comparison
question: How does CoreML compute-unit selection change prefill and decode performance for the same GPT-2 artifact?

controls.artifact: One unchanged more-ane-transformers conversion shared by all configurations
controls.precision: Same FP16 graph/weights and FP32 layer_norm policy; numerical arithmetic remains backend-dependent
controls.host: Same Apple M1 8 GB macOS machine, one process/session
controls.inputs: Identical HF float32 greedy decode token IDs for all backends within each prompt case
controls.cache: Zero KV cache for every request; no prompt prefix reuse
controls.warmup: Two 16-step generations immediately before every timed trial; separate correctness replay excluded
controls.trials: Four per backend per prompt; balanced Latin square backend order, with all three prompt cases evaluated in each single-model block
controls.diagnostics: Full-logit correctness checks outside timed trials; finite native argmax checks included in request timer
controls.model_residency: One model configuration at a time, discarded before loading the next; HF reference model runs in a separate child process

configurations.all: ALL: CPU/GPU/ANE allowed; does not require all three to execute

metrics.prefill_actual_tokens_per_second: Actual prompt tokens divided by first-prediction seconds; never use the padded width as token count
metrics.warm_ttft_ms: Zero-cache reset, input assembly, prediction, KV handoff, first native greedy argmax; excludes compilation/loading, HTTP/UI and detokenization
metrics.decode_engine_steps_per_second: 64 synchronized prediction calls divided by their summed durations
metrics.decode_request_steps_per_second: 64 steps including input assembly, prediction, KV handoff, full-vocabulary argmax and autorelease cleanup
metrics.startup: Model load durations recorded separately; compilation/profile setup excluded
metrics.statistics: Raw trial and step samples, aggregate throughput, latency percentiles, and exploratory paired whole-trial bootstrap intervals
metrics.placement_source: Fresh MLComputePlan queries, or a prior plan report whose complete model-file hashes match; source recorded

quality.strict_trace_gate: Finite logits, zero HF top1 mismatches across prompt plus 64 decode predictions, and maximum KL(HF||CoreML) <= 0.01 nats
quality.additional_evidence: 16-token free greedy continuation checked against HF for each case/configuration
quality.interpretation: Trace gate and generation smoke are limited to these prompts; they do not establish general model accuracy or full-logit parity

interpretation.cpu_and_ne_vs_cpu_only: Controlled CoreML CPU/ANE allowance comparison on the same graph
interpretation.all_vs_cpu_and_gpu: Compare compute-unit allowance, then inspect preferred-device plan; if ALL prefers only GPU, no ANE speedup attribution is allowed
interpretation.placement: MLComputePlan preferred-device counts are static metadata, not measured runtime utilization or overlap
interpretation.thermal: Report each trial's start/end thermal state; qualify conclusions if any state is not nominal
interpretation.uncertainty: One session with four paired blocks; repeat separate sessions before claiming stable small speedups
interpretation.cross_implementation: Orion has different graph shapes, cache and arithmetic policies; retain its numbers separately as implementation context
interpretation.excluded: Qwen/oMLX, pure GPU claims, pure ANE claims, peak hardware rankings, and Asahi performance
